1	const axios = require('axios')
2	const Logger = require('../Logger')
3	
4	class GoogleBooks {
5	  #responseTimeout = 10000
6	
7	  constructor() {}
8	
9	  extractIsbn(industryIdentifiers) {
10	    if (!industryIdentifiers || !industryIdentifiers.length) return null
11	
12	    var isbnObj = industryIdentifiers.find((i) => i.type === 'ISBN_13') || industryIdentifiers.find((i) => i.type === 'ISBN_10')
13	    if (isbnObj && isbnObj.identifier) return isbnObj.identifier
14	    return null
15	  }
16	
17	  cleanResult(item) {
18	    var { id, volumeInfo } = item
19	    if (!volumeInfo) return null
20	    const { title, subtitle, authors, publisher, publisherDate, description, industryIdentifiers, categories, imageLinks } = volumeInfo
21	
22	    let cover = null
23	    // Selects the largest cover assuming the largest is the last key in the object
24	    if (imageLinks && Object.keys(imageLinks).length) {
25	      cover = imageLinks[Object.keys(imageLinks).pop()]
26	      cover = cover?.replace(/^http:/, 'https:') || null
27	    }
28	
29	    return {
30	      id,
31	      title,
32	      subtitle: subtitle || null,
33	      author: authors ? authors.join(', ') : null,
34	      publisher,
35	      publishedYear: publisherDate ? publisherDate.split('-')[0] : null,
36	      description,
37	      cover,
38	      genres: categories && Array.isArray(categories) ? [...categories] : null,
39	      isbn: this.extractIsbn(industryIdentifiers)
40	    }
41	  }
42	
43	  /**
44	   * Search for a book by title and author
45	   * @param {string} title
46	   * @param {string} author
47	   * @param {number} [timeout] response timeout in ms
48	   * @returns {Promise<Object[]>}
49	   **/
50	  async search(title, author, timeout = this.#responseTimeout) {
51	    if (!timeout || isNaN(timeout)) timeout = this.#responseTimeout
52	
53	    title = encodeURIComponent(title)
54	    let queryString = `q=intitle:${title}`
55	    if (author) {
56	      author = encodeURIComponent(author)
57	      queryString += `+inauthor:${author}`
58	    }
59	    const url = `https://www.googleapis.com/books/v1/volumes?${queryString}`
60	    Logger.debug(`[GoogleBooks] Search url: ${url}`)
61	    const items = await axios
62	      .get(url, {
63	        timeout
64	      })
65	      .then((res) => {
66	        if (!res || !res.data || !res.data.items) return []
67	        return res.data.items
68	      })
69	      .catch((error) => {
70	        Logger.error('[GoogleBooks] Volume search error', error.message)
71	        return []
72	      })
73	    return items.map((item) => this.cleanResult(item))
74	  }
75	}
76	
77	module.exports = GoogleBooks

content.text:
I converted 7 files in my folders and skipped 5 that can't pass the rules without a cast or a runtime change. The final `npx tsc -p tsconfig.check.json` run shows no errors in objects/, providers/ or scanner/, and none in converted files elsewhere caused by my changes. I did not run the build or tests and made no commits. My 7 renames are staged by `git mv`, but the content edits are not, so each file needs `git add`.

## 1. Files converted
| File | `!` | index signatures | `as` casts | removed requires |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| server/objects/settings/EmailSettings.ts | 0 | 2 (class; `EmailSettingsUpdatePayload`) | 0 | 0 |
| server/objects/settings/NotificationSettings.ts | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| server/objects/settings/ServerSettings.ts | 0 | 2 (class; `ServerSettingsUpdatePayload`) | 0 | 0 |
| server/objects/metadata/AudioMetaTags.ts | 0 | 2 (class; `AudioMetaTagsData`) | 0 | 0 |
| server/objects/DeviceInfo.ts | 0 | 2 (class; `DeviceInfoData`) | 0 | 0 |
| server/objects/DailyLog.ts | 0 | 0 | 3 (one `libs/dateAndTime` alias, two fsExtra `writeFile` call sites; each has a comment) | 0 |
| server/providers/AudiobookCovers.ts | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

No `import type` replaced a require; the only new type-only reference (DailyLog's `LogObject`) adds no require. Other notes:
- **ServerSettings:** borrows two file-local declarations from earlier converted files: `declare function isNaN(value: unknown)` (from BookFinder.ts) and `declare const global`.
- **EmailSettings:** the update-payload interface uses a get/set pair for `ereaderDevices`. Without it, `.filter((d) => d)` is typed as keeping nulls.

## 2. Skipped or not reached
- **Backup.js:** `this.key == 1` compares a string with a number (TS2367). Fixing it needs a false type or a runtime change.
- **files/LibraryFile.js:** `getFileTimestampsWithIno` returns `false | {...}`, and `setDataFromPath` uses the result unguarded (`setData(fileTsData)`, `fileTsData.ino`).
- **providers/MusicBrainz.js:** calls `axios.get` with three arguments (TS2554).
- **providers/GoogleBooks.js:** `imageLinks[Object.keys(imageLinks).pop()]` indexes with `string | undefined` (TS2538).
- **scanner/MediaProbeData.js:** `construct()` passes `probeData[key]` (dynamic key, so `unknown`) to `new AudioMetaTags`, which would need a cast.
- **Not reached (time):** PlaybackSession, PodcastEpisodeDownload, files/AudioFile, iTunes, FantLab, Audible, Audnexus, CustomProviderAdapter, the small scanner files (Nfo, Opf, AbsMetadata, LibraryScan), Stream, and all the large scanner files.

## 3. `declare module` blocks needed
None. DeviceInfo uses the existing `uuid` declaration through `/// <reference path>`.

## 4. Remaining tsc errors
None in my folders. The only 7 errors in the program are in server/managers/EmailManager.ts (nodemailer TS7016 plus TS7006s). They come from the other agent's conversion, not from my types.

## 5. Bugs noticed (not fixed)
- **MusicBrainz.js:43:** `axios.get(url, { params: query }, config)`. The third argument is ignored, so the User-Agent header is never sent.
- **GoogleBooks.js:20/35:** it reads `volumeInfo.publisherDate`, but the API field is `publishedDate`, so `publishedYear` is always null.
- **LibraryFile.js:64–71:** on a stat failure, `setData(false)` runs and `ino` silently becomes undefined.
- **Backup.js:37:** the loose `== 1` also matches `' 1'`, `'01'` and `'1.0'`.
- **AudioMetaTags.js `isEqual`:** it only compares keys set on the other object, so it returns true when `this` has extra tags.
- **NotificationSettings.js `update`:** if the payload has no `appriseApiUrl` and the current value is null, `undefined !== null` reports an update every time.
- **NotificationSettings.js `createNotification`:** it throws when `payload.urls` is missing.

## 6. Worth double-checking
- **Constructor types for Setting.js:** the parameters are `EmailSettingsData | null = null`, `NotificationSettingsData | null = null` and `settings?: ServerSettingsData | null`, so `undefined` is accepted. The data types aren't exported; get them with `ConstructorParameters<typeof X>[0]`. EmailSettingsData requires host, port, user, pass, testAddress and fromAddress. NotificationSettingsData requires appriseType. ServerSettingsData is `Partial<toJSON>` plus two legacy keys. `se.value` (Object) will still need a boundary cast in Setting.ts.
- **Honest `| undefined` on some ServerSettings fields:** the code copies them without a default, so `tokenSecret`, `scannerParseSubtitle`, `homeBookshelfView` and `authOpenIDSubfolderForRedirectURLs` include `| undefined`. DeviceInfo's `userId` also includes `| undefined`, because `setData` is passed `req.user?.id`.
- **What require() returns:**
  - AudiobookCovers uses `require('axios').default`, as OpenLibrary already does; it is the same object.
  - DailyLog aliases `const date = dateAndTime`. `format()` uses `this`, and it is still called as a method on the same object.
- **Shape and hoisting:** every file ends with `export =` and nothing after it. Static initialisers (`ServerSettings.patchableSettingsKeys`, `DeviceInfo.stringFields`) and `#responseTimeout` are unchanged. All fields use `declare`. Every import used only as a type is `type X = import(...)`, so no runtime require was added or dropped.
- **Changed types seen by other TS files:** LogManager.ts now sees the typed DailyLog and BookFinder.ts the typed AudiobookCovers; both type-check cleanly.
